text.card: WASP-12 is a 6,265 K star 427 parsecs away with 1 known transiting planet.
text.introduction: WASP-12 is a star of 6,265 K 427 parsecs away. Its planet WASP-12 b crosses it, which is how it was found and sized.

quotes.title: WASP-12
quotes.card: WASP-12 is a magnitude 11 yellow dwarf star located approximately 1347 light-years away in the constellation Auriga.
quotes.introduction: WASP-12 has a mass and radius similar to the Sun and is known for being orbited by a planet that is extremely hot and has a retrograde orbit around WASP-12.
